sections.title: Built for Plates, Nothing Else
sections.description: Learn why a dedicated rotor changes plate-based throughput on the Kubota Plate Spin 3.
body: Most centrifuges treat plate handling as one option among several, a plate rotor that competes for slot time with tube-based rotors, and has to be swapped in and out. Plate Spin 3 removes that trade-off entirely: the plate rotor is equipped with the main unit, not sold or configured separately, so a lab running plate-based work exclusively never spends time on a rotor decision at all.

That focus pays off directly in capacity. 6 microplates, or 2 × 96-hole PCR plates, or 2 deep well plates, cover the three formats a high-throughput screening or PCR workflow actually needs, without diluting the design to also handle standard tubes.
